items.title: Collapsed or expanded, one click
items.text: The pin and hover-to-open are gone. A button at the top of the bar switches between an icon rail and the full list, and the sidebar glides open and shut.

items.title: Drag to reorder
items.text: Drag icons or rows up and down and the others shift to make room, in either mode. The order is the sidebar's own; your split layout doesn't move.

items.title: A tray for stashed panes
items.text: Below the last pane, past a divider, sits the tray. Drag a pane in to stash it, or drag it out to bring it back.

items.title: Tiles you can tell apart
items.text: Each icon is a raised tile in its pane's own hue with a kind glyph. Busy panes shine, a waiting question shows as an accent rim, and rows have a close button in place of trash mode.

items.title: Collapsed panes are blades
items.text: Minimized panes tuck under each other as overlaid bars with shadows leaning outward, and panes can be smaller before they stack.

items.title: Calmer focus on glass
items.text: Changing focus now changes only a pane's rim and glow, not its whole sheet.

items.title: Fixes
items.text: Double-clicking a divider evens out panes only in that divider's direction, and a collapsed pane with a banner no longer shows a pale patch on its strip.
